name: @pipeworx/mcp-prnewswire

tools.name: prnewswire_latest_releases
tools.description: Latest press releases from PR Newswire's site-wide RSS feed (source: prnewswire.com). Returns headline, issuer, published time, excerpt and industry tags for each release, newest first. Covers the ~20 most recent releases across all categories — not PR Newswire's full archive.

since_hours.description: Only return releases published within the last N hours (optional).

tools.name: prnewswire_search_releases
tools.description: Keyword/company search over PR Newswire's current site-wide feed (source: prnewswire.com). Matches against headline, issuer name, excerpt and industry tags. Searches only the live rolling ~20-item window each call — not a historical archive.

query.description: Company name or keyword to match.

tools.name: prnewswire_get_release
tools.description: Fetch one specific PR Newswire release by its URL (source: prnewswire.com), as returned by prnewswire_latest_releases or prnewswire_search_releases. Re-fetches the live feed each call — a release that has scrolled off the current ~20-item window will not be found.

url.description: The release URL (from a prior prnewswire tool call).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-prnewswire forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the prnewswire pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
